critic.finite_G_limitation: Recorded teacher rewards only; no unknown post-horizon continuation and no SAC entropy terms. Not an unbiased estimate of stochastic soft-policy Q.
critic.derivatives: Per-state derivatives of Q1/Q2/min Q wrt joint actions; teammate held at BC mean during single-agent perturbations.
critic.jvp: Exact update-1 Q parameter gradient mapped through each pre-update actor mean Jacobian; update-1 actor gradient used the Q after the env1001 critic step.

conclusion_note: Review interventions, both-agent drift and paired evaluation before assigning a causal mechanism.
causal_findings: Fixed critics alone suffice for large deterministic drift and collapse in this window; moving critic targets are not necessary.
Removing only Q actor gradients reduces validation drift by approximately 78/90 percent but yields only 1/10 ever-success after 100 updates.
Snapshot teammate ordering gives virtually the same drift and 0/10; actor0 update1 is bitwise equal to sequential control.
Removing entropy alone leaves 0/10; removing both SAC actor terms leaves smaller but nonzero drift and only 4/10 at update100, with 0/10 at update1/10.
Critic ranking systematically prefers the generated actions on the 128 sampled states, but finite-horizon teacher G is not an unbiased soft-policy Q reference.
No implementation bug has been demonstrated; a single mechanism does not explain all paired-success failures.
classification: causal diagnostics; no production bug fix or stabilization treatment applied
